_about: The App Store's second set of pictures (27 Nov 2026, Audrey: "they need better finishing and polish"; her picks: the wooden farm sign, "My 8" and fishing). Each picture: [scene, title, line under it], in order; compose2.mjs puts them on the farm sign. Scenes from web3d/storescenes.mjs (hero, farm, coop, snow, groom, shop, fish) and web3d/intropics.mjs (7 the breeds mingling, 4 the show).
